{event_title}

Date: {event_date}

{event_description}
{additional_notes_block} """ def _escape_html(text: Optional[str]) -> str: """ Escape special HTML characters to prevent XSS attacks. If the input is None, return an empty string. """ if text is None: return "" # html.escape handles &, <, >, " and '. return html.escape(text, quote=True) def generate_event_invite( title: str, description: str, date: str, notes: Optional[str] = None ) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML invitation for an event. Returns ------- str Sanitized HTML string ready for safe display. """ # Sanitize all user supplied content safe_title = _escape_html(title) safe_description = _escape_html(description).replace("\n", "

" if safe_notes else "" ) # Render the final HTML using the template return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( event_title=safe_title, event_date=safe_date, event_description=safe_description, additional_notes_block=additional_notes_block )
